Fuckball third-party components

Source: https://github.com/wxyz-abcd/node-haxball

Files: haxball.js, renderer.js, language.js
Renderer and language browser-global entry points adapted from the CommonJS originals.

JSON5
Source: https://github.com/json5/json5
Browser distribution vendored from node-haxball/examples_web/src/vendor/json5.min.js
License: MIT (see LICENSE-json5.txt)

Source: node-haxball/examples_web/src/vendor/pako-jszip.min.js
pako: https://github.com/nodeca/pako
License: MIT and Zlib (see LICENSE-pako.txt)
JSZip: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
License: MIT (see LICENSE-jszip.txt)

QR rendering:

  Used only to render native room invites locally; no external QR service.
